Participation is also projected to increase sixfold for the upcoming event. This expansion will foster India's growing healthcare ecosystem. The expo aims to connect various healthcare value chain participants.

items.title: What is the market smoking on ITC? Why the stock appears to be completely ignored by investors? Explained

Investors are closely monitoring the European Central Bank's upcoming interest rate decision, while a sharp decline in Novartis stock and German political uncertainty following regional elections further weighed on overall market sentiment.

The agreement focuses on structuring and rolling out three new clean energy initiatives. These projects will enhance grid stability and meet peak electricity demands. Madhya Pradesh's renewable energy policy guides these future developments.

items.summary: Rising sugar prices are pushing packaged food companies towards another round of price hikes or smaller pack sizes. Bikaji Foods is rolling out a 2% price increase across its sweets portfolio, while analysts at Anand Rathi expect 2-5% hikes or shrinkflation in packaged foods as sugar, tea and coffee prices rise.

The acquisition of Pernia's Pop-Up Shop in 2018 played a role in the considerable revenue growth from FY20 to FY24. Nevertheless, analysts caution investors regarding the expanding losses and the company's currently high valuation.

ICICI Securities has initiated coverage on Amagi Media Labs and Prime Focus with Buy ratings, citing opportunities from cloud adoption, digital advertising, VFX spending and evolving content consumption.

This collaboration seeks to improve manufacturing practices and product quality, addressing the heightened global demand for stainless steel across multiple sectors. Jindal aims to advance operational excellence and increase customer satisfaction through this strategic partnership.

items.title: India bonds muted after tepid response for RBI's cash-drain operation
items.summary: Indian government bonds hit a pause on Monday following a technical setback that disrupted cash withdrawal capabilities. To counteract a liquidity overflow that surged to a historic 10.73 trillion rupees last Friday, the central bank declared an overnight auction. Traders are now on edge, fearing that tighter measures may be imposed to handle the liquidity, especially with increasing oil prices and rate speculation keeping market sentiment tepid.

items.summary: With a bigger capital cushion, financial institutions may also be asked to do more to mobilize resources in capital markets, analysts say.

items.summary: Morgan Stanley sees India entering a multi-quarter growth upcycle, supported by improving investments, monetary policy and domestic demand. The brokerage expects the Sensex to reach 89,000 by June 2027 in its base case, while assigning 25% probabilities to a bull-case target of 100,000 and a bear-case target of 66,000.

items.summary: Japan’s government bond yields rose on Monday as investors turned cautious ahead of the five-year JGB auction and reassessed expectations for further Bank of Japan rate hikes. Super-long yields rebounded after last week’s sharp decline, while markets continued to price in a 25-basis-point BOJ rate hike next week and another increase by January.

items.title: PM Modi's call to cut gold purchases & 15% tax change India's import numbers
items.summary: Modi’s renewed call to curb gold purchases comes as the government seeks to reduce India’s gold import bill and put some of the estimated 31,000 tonnes of household-held gold into circulation. Gold imports fell each month after a similar appeal in May — by nearly 4% in May, 20% in June, 23.7% in July and nearly 30% in August.

items.title: Understanding futures grid trading and the risks of automated strategies
items.summary: Futures grid trading presents a methodical way to navigate the unpredictable terrain of crypto markets. By segmenting price ranges into distinct levels for execution, this automated strategy enables traders to efficiently adjust to market dynamics without needing to constantly monitor activities. Nevertheless, the use of leverage and susceptibility to market disruptions introduce important risks; thus, selecting appropriate parameters and applying diligent risk management is essential for effective grid trading.

items.title: Novartis India to acquire Pfizer's 'Minipress' trademark for Rs 1,250 crore
items.summary: Novartis India will acquire the Minipress and Minipres trademarks and related intellectual property from Pfizer for about ₹1,250 crore. Minipress XL, used for hypertension and benign prostatic hyperplasia, generated ₹228.6 crore in revenue as of July 2026, according to IQVIA data.

items.summary: Air India's chairman highlighted safety and customer trust as key priorities. Operational excellence and financial sustainability are also crucial for the airline's future. The RBI may deploy additional reverse repos, market stabilisation bonds and sell-buy swaps to drain excess liquidity.

items.summary: Sebi’s revised ETF trading rules have come into effect from September 7, changing how price bands and reference prices are determined. The new framework introduces dynamic price bands based on underlying assets and a pre-open auction for gold and silver ETFs, aiming to improve price discovery and reduce premiums or discounts to NAV.

The government aims to boost exports of bananas significantly in coming years. This move seeks to enhance India's global market share in banana production. Stakeholder consultations are currently underway for this proposed policy change.

items.title: GST Council meeting likely to be postponed, say sources
items.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting, scheduled for September 12, is likely to be postponed, with a final decision expected after consultations with states. The meeting was set to discuss several ease-of-doing-business measures, including protecting buyers’ ITC when suppliers fail to deposit GST, simplifying taxation of corporate guarantees, allowing ITC on certain employee-related expenses and enabling small businesses to obtain GST registrations across multiple states.

items.title: CIL offers additional coal to power plants as stocks decline: Here's what led to critically low levels
items.summary: Coal India has offered additional coal to power plants amid critically low stocks, with prolonged rains disrupting mining and transportation. As rainfall eases, production and coal evacuation are expected to improve.

items.title: India emerges as key diesel supplier to Europe as Russian, US flows falter
items.summary: India now supplies sixty percent of diesel transiting Bab-el-Mandeb to Europe. Russian diesel exports remain severely constrained due to ongoing disruptions. US shipments to Europe have also begun to weaken significantly. Indian refineries are filling a crucial gap in Europe's eastern diesel supply.

items.title: Punjab cabinet approves 3 foodgrain policies for Kharif 2026-27
items.summary: The Punjab Cabinet approved key policies for paddy procurement and movement in 2026-27. Amendments to Punjab Public Service Commission regulations were also sanctioned by the council. Thirty-three hospital posts were revived, and 138 new healthcare positions were created. Eighty vacant Medical Officer (Dental) posts will be filled by the department. These decisions aim to enhance public services and farmer support across the state.
